notes: Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Primary product team evaluating chat agent for customer support and in-app assistant.
Use-case specifics: real-time streaming responses, tool-calling to internal systems (ticket lookup, account actions), multi-turn context up to ~6k tokens.
Latency SLO: aiming for 95th <= 300ms for NA; EU target 95th <= 350ms. Cost sensitive but will trade some cost for predictable latency.

Routing requirements: prefer smart routing by geo + cost tier, automatic fallback to lower-cost model when Dedicated capacity saturated. Must support region-aware failover without data residency violation.
Quote from CPO on 10/25: "We need streaming that's indistinguishable from in-app typing lag — buffering >200ms will hurt adoption."
POC configuration: Hosted API with streaming enabled, tool-calling sandbox, prefix caching turned on for common intents. SE instrumented token-level tracing.

Security: require SSO/SAML for console access, KMS integration for customer-managed keys in Dedicated, audit log export to SIEM. Legal asked about retention controls and data residency for EU customers.

Economics: preference to start on Hosted API for speed to market, then move to Dedicated if predictable qps and lower unit cost justify commit. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization to save cost.
